Throughout the Middle Ages, the name functioned as a title used for regional governors and other high-ranking figures. Its association with power and leadership has cemented its place as a significant moniker for generations. Eventually, it transitioned into a given name and spread globally, embodying the aspirations of parents seeking a powerful and noble name for their child.
